title: Family Outdoor Group Portrait, 1955 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century family snapshot captured outdoors against a home's wooden siding in August 1955. The photo shows multiple generations gathered together, including men in casual collared shirts, a woman in a dress, and younger family members. The print features a classic 1950s scalloped deckle edge and a faint double-exposure or light reflection visual effect across the image area. Margins display the date imprint '55' along the side.
